normalized_matching_profile.description: Description 30A Escapes presents… "Almost Heaven", your ultimate Gulf-view retreat in Dune Allen Beach! This stunning home features a private heated pool, exclusive deeded beach access, and breathtaking views from the 4th-floor crow’s nest. With five bedrooms, multiple living areas, and a chef’s kitchen, comfort and luxury await you. Explore the scenic Dune Allen community on 7 included bikes or relax on the private patio as you grill dinner and enjoy the Gulf breeze.*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Steps to the Beach: Private and deeded beach access avoids crowdsPrivate Pool: Complemented with patio seating, dining, and grilling options. Pool is heated September-April.Unparalleled Crow’s Nest Views: Gulf and Dune Lake vistas, perfect for sunrises and sunsetsStocked and Functional: Chef’s kitchen, extra fridge, and ice maker in the bar areaElevator Access: Effortless connection between all levelsSleeping Arrangements: 5 bedrooms for up to 12 guests, each with en-suite bathroomsFamily Entertainment Ready: Multiple living spaces, patio TV, and outdoor diningPrime Location: Dune Allen Beach, near Topsail State Park and local dining7 Bikes Included: Cruiser bikes for exploring 30AEager to Read More?Here Are A Few Kind Words From Our Previous Guests:⭐ “Wonderful days and nights. Views of the water were fantastic. Going up to the 4th level in the nest was the perfect spot for sunset.” - Martha P.⭐ “This home has everything in the description and MORE! Every level offers a unique experience and perspective as you feel as though you are 'almost to heaven.'” - Gigi F.⭐ “The view from the top level is absolutely stunning. The private beach access and pool make it so peaceful and relaxing. You will never want to leave!” - Gailey B.⭐“Perfect location! The private beach access is great to avoid crowds. We loved the extra fridge and watching fireworks from the crow’s nest!” - Jennifer W.*** YOUR PERFECT 30A BEACH ESCAPE ***Welcome to Almost Heaven, a luxurious retreat perfectly situated in the sought-after Dune Allen Beach community. Nestled between the emerald waters of the Gulf of Mexico and the peaceful beauty of a serene dune lake, this stunning property is a true gem on 30A. With exclusive private beach access just steps away, you'll enjoy the convenience of avoiding crowded spots while soaking in the natural tranquility.The home boasts breathtaking views, from the sparkling Gulf to the picturesque surroundings, and offers a thoughtful design to create the perfect balance of relaxation and connection. Whether lounging by the private heated pool, taking in sunsets from the 4th-floor crow’s nest, or gathering in the open living spaces, Almost Heaven promises an unforgettable escape for families and groups alike.*** LIVING AREAS ***Bright and Open: Spacious living room filled with natural light from large sliding glass doorsCozy Comfort: Plush sectional sofa and gas fireplace create a warm and inviting atmosphereEntertainment Ready: Smart TV perfect for movie nights or catching up on your favorite showsIndoor-Outdoor Flow: Sliding doors open to the private patio and pool for seamless connectivityElevator Access: Conveniently connects all levels, making the home easily accessible for every guest*** 4TH FLOOR CROW’S NEST ***Unparalleled Views: Stunning Gulf and dune lake vistas, perfect for sunsets or fireworksLeisure Space: Comfortable seating to relax and take in the serene surroundingsGame Table: Perfect for family fun, friendly competition, or casual entertainmentConvenience: Equipped with a mini fridge for drinks and snacksEntertainment: Smart TV for enjoying your favorite shows or moviesElevated Escape: A peaceful and scenic retreat offering a unique perspective of Dune Allen Beach*** KITCHEN AND DINING ***Chef’s Kitchen: Expansive counters with ample prep space and modern appliancesBar Seating: Island seating for four, perfect for casual meals or conversationsFormal Dining: Large table with seating for ten, ideal for family dinners or entertainingOutdoor Dining: Additional al fresco seating for eight on the private patioFully Stocked: Equipped with cookware, utensils, and serving dishes for all your culinary needsOpen Design: Seamless connection between the kitchen, dining, and outdoor spaces*** OUTDOOR PRIVATE OASIS ***Private Pool: Year-round enjoyment with a shallow lounge area. The pool can be heated September-April.Grill and Dine: Built-in grill, patio TV, and seating for al fresco mealsRelaxation Space: Comfortable loungers and shaded dining areaSpacious Patio: Plenty of room for family gatherings and outdoor funGulf Breeze Retreat: A serene and versatile space to unwind and connect*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***1st Floor:Powder Room: Conveniently located off the Laundry Room2nd Floor:Queen Guest Suite: Queen bed, flat-screen TV, En-suite with single vanity and walk-in showerQueen Guest Suite: Two Queen beds,flat-screen TV, En-suite with single vanity and walk-in showerBunk Room: Twin bunk bed, En-suite with single vanity and shower/tub combo3rd Floor:Primary King Suite: King bed, Gulf views, private balcony, En-suite with dual vanities, soaking tub and walk-in showerKing Guest Suite: King bed, flat-screen TV, En-suite with single vanity and walk-in shower*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY ***Tranquil Atmosphere: Quiet, laid-back vibe with pristine beach accessPrivate and Deeded Beach Access: Exclusive access ensures privacy and avoids crowdsOutdoor Adventures: Explore Topsail State Park’s trails and sugar-white dunesLocal Favorites: Stinky’s Fish Camp, a 3-minute bike ride away*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included in our quotes. It can be purchased during the reservation process or obtained independently We DO NOT accept wire transfers for paymentWaiver required to get access to the 7 provided bikes. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A Escapes.Private Pool is heated from September 1st–April 30th.There is an active Ring doorbell camera at the front door of the home.*** YOUR STAY - OUR PRIORITY ***At 30A Escapes, we’re committed to providing a luxurious, safe, and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 support and an immaculate home designed for comfort and relaxation.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***TDT #: 82378STRO #: STR24-002120
